blocks.content:
Act: Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
Type: Statutory Body
Chairperson: Former CJI
Tenure: 3 years / 70 years
Advisory recommendations
Civil court powers

items: Tenure criteria (3 years or 70 years of age) is a frequently asked question in RRB and competitive exams.
Remember that the body holds Civil court powers, but its findings are advisory recommendations.
Identify its status specifically as a Statutory Body established in 1993.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Constituted under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
Functions as an independent Statutory Body.
The Chairperson position is held by a Former Chief Justice of India (CJI).
Tenure of service is limited to 3 years or until reaching 70 years of age.
Holds civil court powers while its recommendations remain advisory in nature.
